seo.title: Redis GUI for {macDevices}
seo.description: Browse Redis keys as a tree split on colons, edit names, TTLs and string values, and run commands with redis-cli quoting on Standalone, Sentinel, Cluster.

header.title: Redis GUI
header.lead: Browse keys as a tree and run commands on Standalone, Sentinel or Cluster deployments, Valkey included.

bands.title: Connect
text: Choose <ui>Connection Mode</ui>: Standalone, Sentinel or Cluster. Sentinel follows the primary after failover, and Cluster discovers shards from a seed member and routes each command to the shard that owns its key. Valkey servers connect the same way as Redis.
Sign in with a password, or fill in Username to sign in as a Redis 6 ACL user. On Amazon ElastiCache, an <cloudAuth>AWS IAM</cloudAuth> mode turns a short-lived token into the password, with TLS on.
New connections start with TLS off. Upstash, Redis Cloud and similar services require it, and a pasted rediss:// URL turns it on; there is no fallback to plain text, so Preferred behaves as Required.

bands.title: Keys and commands
text: Browse keys in folders split on colons, or on another separator, with each key’s type, TTL, length and value. Collections show their first entries, and non-UTF-8 values open in the hex editor. Edit key names, TTLs and string values in the grid, and Add Row creates hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets or strings. Filters on names and types run server-side, with SCAN MATCH and SCAN TYPE.

Commands take redis-cli quoting, and unknown ones are sent as written. DB 3 GET key reads another database without moving the session, and inside MULTI replies stay queued until EXEC. Safe Mode treats commands on its read list, such as GET, as reads and any other as a write; FLUSHDB and FLUSHALL always ask first.

moveData: <export>Export</export> keys or command results as {exportFormats}. To load data, run commands in the editor.
iphone: Run Redis commands in the Query tab of a Standalone connection, signed in with a password, over TLS with a CA or client certificate, or through an SSH tunnel with a password or a key.

faq.question: Why is the key tree empty for my ACL user?
faq.answer: The key tree reads key names with SCAN and their types with TYPE. Grant both, for example ACL SETUSER app +scan +type, then right-click Keys in the sidebar and choose Refresh.

faq.question: Why does SELECT not change the sidebar?
faq.answer: SELECT moves only the editor’s session, so the sidebar and the key tree stay where you clicked. Click a database in the sidebar to move both, or prefix one command with DB and the database number.

faq.question: Why does a managed Redis service list databases it does not have?
faq.answer: Upstash, Redis Cloud and ElastiCache refuse CONFIG, so TablePro cannot read how many databases they hold and lists a default range. On a service with one database, the others show the server’s error when you open them.

otherTools.text: Redis Insight has a command Workbench, a Pub/Sub workspace, a profiler, slow logs and memory analysis, while TablePro works with Redis beside your SQL databases; the <compare>comparisons</compare> cover other clients that do both.
